name: black-friday-daily-ad-spend-decisions
description: Use for "which campaigns should we scale today on Black Friday", "what should we cut during the sale", "are we on track to spend the Black Friday ad budget", "why did our CPA jump on Cyber Monday", or a daily check inside a BFCM or Prime Day sale. Use when the decision is today's scale, cut or hold, with the wait stated for conversions still arriving. Google Ads, Facebook Ads and TikTok Ads, with Shopify where connected.
